title: ChemBmin-P

sections.heading: ChemBmin-P
sections.text: Trace mineral deficiencies are a common bottleneck in poultry nutrition, leading to reduced growth, compromised immunity, and elevated mortality. Conventional mineral supplements frequently suffer from low bioavailability, diminishing their efficacy. ChemBmin-P employs advanced Hydroxy amino acid based green chelation technology to complex essential trace minerals—copper, manganese, zinc, and iron—ensuring they remain stable and highly bioavailable. This enhances their absorption and metabolic utility, even in challenging feed matrices. *Project supported by the Technology Development Board, Government of India Components Copper 0.8% Manganese 4% Zinc 4% Ferrous 0.5% Additional micro-trace minerals included for comprehensive nutritional support
